label: Late copy phase, fed-back token in {w,b,m,t,g,z,0,j,a}
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), and only on repeated input tokens (in_first == 0, which is automatic in the copy phase). It never fires at recall_idx 0-1. Its rate rises steadily with position in the copy, from 1.7% at recall_idx 2 to 35% at recall_idx 8, and with absolute t; 43% of mass is on the final output step. It also depends strongly on the identity of the fed-back input token (= the previously copied original token). The rate is graded: w 22%, b 21%, m 18%, t 17%, g 15%, then z/0/j/a around 9-11%, and low for e, k, v and others. The strongest activations are on late copy steps whose input is b, w or m. The hard token set plus position cutoff tops out around F1 0.64 on dev (mass recall 0.79), because token preference is graded and misses include short sequences (L=3-4) firing on the last steps with tokens outside the set. The output token and the first token have only weak effects.
